title: Bind dice-based magic item spell durations
description: Extend item-sourced start_effect duration binding to represent finite spell durations whose amount is dice-based (for example, durations parsed as 1d4 hours). Current item effect import faithfully binds finite numeric durations and keeps dice-based spell durations unbound because active-effect duration binding expects a numeric amount and has no linked roll evidence. Preserve exact spellRef provenance and do not substitute averages or fixed defaults.
acceptance_criteria:
- Dice-based item spell durations bind only when their duration roll is deterministically resolved and linked to the created active effect.
- No average, maximum, or fabricated fixed duration is substituted.
- Unsupported or unrolled duration remains explicitly unbound.
- Regression tests cover successful evidence-backed binding and fail-closed behavior without roll evidence.
notes: 2026-10-14: to be satisfied by PR #663 repair eshyra-olc5.11.5 (engine rolls typed dice durations; DM overrides are explicit and unbound). Close when #663 merges if the AC mapping holds.
close_reason: Satisfied by PR #663 (1d96a50a) via eshyra-olc5.11.5: dice durations bind only from engine roll linked to the effect with replayable evidence; no averages/defaults; unrolled caller values refused, explicit overrides stored unbound; permanent tests for both paths.
